auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Register or sign in at https://mcp.finchina.com/intro to obtain your FinChina API Key. Queries consume FinChina credits; some advanced datasets require account verification. The key is sent in the x-api-key header.

actions.name: discover_tools
actions.description: Call a FinChina query_* or screen_* navigation tool with no arguments to obtain subTools and their parameter schemas. This returns definitions, not business records. Use execute_tool to query a discovered subtool.

toolName.description: An exact query_* or screen_* tool name from list_tools.

inputSchema.description: The navigation tool to inspect after list_tools.

result.description: Decoded FinChina JSON, or the original MCP content when no JSON object is returned.

outputSchema.description: The discovered tool or metadata result.

actions.name: execute_tool
actions.description: Query a FinChina data subtool discovered with discover_tools. Pass its exact name and arguments. Queries consume account credits; this action executes one request without automatic pagination or business retries.

toolName.description: The exact subTools name returned by a navigation tool; not a top-level query_* or screen_* name.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the current schema discovered from FinChina. Preserve upstream field names and pagination parameters.

inputSchema.description: A discovered FinChina data subtool and its arguments.

data.description: Query summary and records. records.headInfo describes the columns; records.data contains positional row arrays. Nested array columns retain their property metadata.

code.description: FinChina business status code, including success with parameter adjustments.

status.description: Business status and diagnostics. Codes below 100 indicate success.

outputSchema.description: FinChina query data and business status, including additional upstream fields.

actions.name: get_company_basic_info
actions.description: Query company basic information and selected indicators through FinChina, such as registered capital. Consumes account credits and executes one query. Discover query_enterprise_profile for the current additional parameters.

items.description: One company name or unified social credit code.

companies.description: Company names or unified social credit codes, up to 100 companies.

indicators.description: Financial or company indicators in Chinese or English; FinChina supports fuzzy matching.

field.description: The indicator or field to sort by, such as 注册资本 or 营业总收入.

sort.description: Sort the query results by one or more fields.

additionalArguments.description: Additional parameters from the discovered subtool schema. Must not repeat fields supplied through companies, indicators, date, or sort.

data.description: Query summary and records. records.headInfo describes the columns; records.data contains positional row arrays. Nested array columns retain their property metadata.

code.description: FinChina business status code, including success with parameter adjustments.

status.description: Business status and diagnostics. Codes below 100 indicate success.

outputSchema.description: FinChina query data and business status, including additional upstream fields.

actions.name: get_company_financial_metrics
actions.description: Query company financial indicators through FinChina, such as revenue over the last three years. Consumes account credits and executes one query. Discover query_enterprise_financial_data for the current additional parameters.

items.description: One company name or unified social credit code.

companies.description: Company names or unified social credit codes, up to 100 companies.

indicators.description: Financial or company indicators in Chinese or English; FinChina supports fuzzy matching.

field.description: The indicator or field to sort by, such as 注册资本 or 营业总收入.

sort.description: Sort the query results by one or more fields.

additionalArguments.description: Additional parameters from the discovered subtool schema. Must not repeat fields supplied through companies, indicators, date, or sort.

date.description: A reporting date or natural-language period, such as 近三年 or 2023年报.

data.description: Query summary and records. records.headInfo describes the columns; records.data contains positional row arrays. Nested array columns retain their property metadata.

code.description: FinChina business status code, including success with parameter adjustments.

status.description: Business status and diagnostics. Codes below 100 indicate success.

outputSchema.description: FinChina query data and business status, including additional upstream fields.

actions.name: get_metadata
actions.description: Query FinChina indicator definitions, enumerations, or parameter metadata through caihui_mcp_metadata. Inspect its current schema using list_tools before supplying arguments.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the current schema discovered from FinChina. Preserve upstream field names and pagination parameters.

inputSchema.description: Arguments for the FinChina metadata tool.

result.description: Decoded FinChina JSON, or the original MCP content when no JSON object is returned.

outputSchema.description: The discovered tool or metadata result.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover FinChina financial and enterprise-risk navigation tools, the execution entry point, and metadata tools with their current input schemas.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for this tool's arguments.

tools.description: Tools exposed by the connected FinChina account.

outputSchema.description: The current FinChina MCP tool catalog.
